AUTHOR: Cutter
TITLE: Automated Detection of Rockfish in Unconstrained Underwater Videos Using Haar Cascades and a New Image Dataset: Labeled Fishes in the Wild
SPECIES: Rockfishes (Sebastes spp.) and associated groundfishes, detected as single 'fish' class
DATA: Labeled Fishes in the Wild (NOAA SWFSC ROV survey imagery 2000-2012)
V_EV: Abstract/Sec. 3.1: 'Detector performance is dependent on ... range to target, variable light intensity and attenuation.' (qualitative only, no measurement)
D2: 929 training/validation still images; independent 211-frame test video (TEST_VIDEO_ROV10)
D_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'the dataset also includes an independent test image set that represents images as they are collected by the moving platform in the ocean.'
R_EV: Sec. 3.1: dataset 'compiled from ROV survey imagery' of 'rocky seabed environments in the ocean, mostly offshore southern California'; test video from same ROV survey program
C_EV: Sec. 4.1/Fig. 5: 'higher TPs (e.g. 82 to 85%) could be achieved by increasing the allowed difference ... but at the expense of higher FPs (8.5 to 12.3)'
E_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'detection performance using the Haar cascade classifiers ranged from 63% to 89% true positive detection rate' (detection metrics only; counting is future work)
ARCH: Haar-feature cascade classifiers (OpenCV v2.4.8, AdaBoost), C#/Accord.NET detector
METR: True positive rate, false alarm count, false positive rate
NOTE: D1 coded video because the test set is a separate ROV video, but leakage risks are not discussed: validation set 'included training images', and 147 negative (non-fish) background images were extracted from both training and test ROV image sets. Training positives are stills from 2000-2012 surveys; whether the test video's survey overlaps training surveys is not stated. V3=Y based on qualitative illumination description ('dimly lit distance', 'illuminated from different directions'). ENV coded temperate rocky seabed (text: 'rocky seabed environments ... offshore southern California'); merged.json says deep sea. NIMG = 929 training + 211 test frames (plus 3167 negatives, 3020 of them from OpenCV tutorial). Operating-point trade-offs are via detector parameters (stages, MHR, size difference, multi-hit suppression) rather than a confidence score. E4: TP rate (recall) reported but FNR not stated explicitly; coded 없음.
